partes.p: Draw a picture of the region of integration of $\displaystyle\int_{0}^{1}\int_{x}^{2x} dy\,dx$.
Find the mass $M$ of the upper half of the annulus $1 < x^{2} + y^{2} < 9$ ($y \geq 0$) with density $\delta = \dfrac{y}{x^{2} + y^{2}}$.
Let C be the curve $x = 1 + y^{3}(1 - y)^{3}$, $0 \leq y \leq 1$. Calculate $\displaystyle\int_{C} \mathbf{F} \cdot d\mathbf{r}$.

Express the work done by the force field $\mathbf{F} = (5x + 3y)\,\hat{\imath} + (1 + \cos y)\,\hat{\jmath}$ on a particle moving counterclockwise once around the unit circle centered at the origin in the form $\displaystyle\int_{a}^{b} f(t)\,dt$. (Do not evaluate the integral; don't even simplify $f(t)$.)
